endorsements.name: Cody Brocious
endorsements.label: My Arduino Can Beat Up Your Hotel Room Lock
endorsements.description: Nearly ten million Onity locks are installed in hotels worldwide, representing 1/3 of hotels and about 50% of hotel locks. Chances are good that you've stayed in dozens of such hotels in your life and you may even be staying in one tonight. This presentation will show, in detail, how they're designed and implemented. Then we will take a look at how they are insecure by design and release a number of critical, unpatchable vulnerabilities.
